companyDescription: Space & Defense · Alpha rocket launches + Blue Ghost lunar · SciTec DoD intelligence + ABMS · $440M FY2026 revenue ramp
priceNote: Jun 25 open. 50% below Jun 1 secondary offering price of $48. SpaceX IPO (Jun 13) triggered capital rotation — FLY fell -19.6% and -11.1% in 2 consecutive days. Analysts: 'selloff unwarranted' (KeyBanc upgrade Jun 16, $50 target). TODAY: Acquired Space-ng for autonomous space ops.
summary: FLY is the #2 pure-play US space launch company — at 50% discount to its own secondary offering price 25 days ago. SpaceX IPO capital rotation crushed the stock; analysts say the selloff was unwarranted. Revenue $440M FY2026 guide (+175% YoY). Buy consensus (9 analysts), avg target $48.22 (+97%). TODAY acquired Space-ng for autonomous ops. 52-week high $73.80 = +202% from here.

catalysts.name: Space-ng Acquisition — Autonomous Space Ops (TODAY)
catalysts.description: Firefly acquired Space-ng (Jun 25, 2026) — adds autonomous space operations capability + Ethan Rublee (co-founder + CEO of Space-ng) as Firefly's Chief Engineer of Software. Positions FLY for autonomous on-orbit servicing market vs just launch.

catalysts.name: $110M US EXIM Loan + Launch Cadence
catalysts.description: FLY expected to secure $110M US Export-Import Bank loan (Reuters Jun 23) for facility expansion to ramp Alpha rocket cadence. More launches = faster revenue ramp toward $440M FY2026 guide. Any launch announcement drives stock.

catalysts.name: NASA MoonFall + Blue Ghost Lunar Ops
catalysts.description: Won $75M NASA JPL MoonFall subcontract (May 26, 2026) — Elytra spacecraft delivers 4 drones to Moon's south pole. Blue Ghost already delivered payloads to lunar surface Feb 2026. NASA Moon Base initiative = FLY is mission-critical for lunar economy.

catalysts.name: SciTec DoD ABMS Contract + Defense Pipeline
catalysts.description: SciTec (Firefly subsidiary) awarded US Air Force contract for Advanced Battle Management System data fusion (Jun 2, 2026). DoD defense revenue diversifies FLY beyond NASA launches — reduces binary risk. More DoD contracts expected.

risks: SpaceX (SPCX) IPO listed Jun 13, 2026 — ongoing capital rotation from small space stocks to SpaceX may continue
Secondary offering 12M shares at $48 (Jun 1) = dilutive; $110M EXIM loan adds leverage for facility expansion
Revenue $440M FY2026 guide requires significant launch cadence ramp — any delay = miss
Market cap $3.91B on $440M revenue = 8.9x P/S, premium valuation requires execution
Space launch is capital-intensive — competition from SpaceX on price and cadence may pressure margins

macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW. Revenue driven by NASA/DoD contracts + commercial launches — not rate-sensitive. Main risk is execution and SpaceX competition, not macro.
